correctness.rationale: The winning rule has precisely the ten stated minimal winning triples; larger coalitions of size >=4 win, smaller coalitions lose. For independent Bernoulli votes each absolute pivotal probability is multiaffine in all other coordinates. Any pair difference is multiaffine, so maxima of its absolute value on [alpha,1-alpha]^6 lie among 64 vertices. Using delta=1-2alpha, an independently implemented signed-subset expansion verified all 64*15=960 integer coefficient polynomials and the exact nine-class signed histogram, including 360 zeros, 150 of each ±delta^2, 60 each of ±(3+delta^2)delta^2/4, 30 each of ±(1-delta^2)delta^2/2 and 60 each of ±(1-delta^2)delta^2/4. The mask-3 witness gives beta_2-beta_4=delta^2 identically; alpha=0 and 1/2 are included. This is an exact polynomial certificate plus a valid continuous multiaffine reduction, not finite numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: Equal-bias fairness is a natural operational guarantee whose robustness fails under voter-specific independent propensities. A sharp quadratic bound for every closed-box perturbation size and an attaining profile is a motivated exact stability invariant; it is not a rephrased common-bias fairness result.
